reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Boosting Toner 210ml
reviews.text: A wonderfully refreshing and hydrating toner! It has a lightweight, watery texture that absorbs instantly without leaving any sticky residue.
reviews.zh: 一款非常清爽又保濕嘅爽膚水！質地輕盈似水，即刻就吸收晒，唔會留低任何黏笠嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Boosting Toner 210ml
reviews.text: I’ve been using this brightening toner for a few weeks, and I really like it. It feels lightweight, hydrates my skin well, and gives my complexion a healthy glow. My skin looks brighter and more even. I would definitely repurchase it! ✨
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款提亮爽膚水幾個星期，真係好鍾意。質地輕盈，保濕效果好好，仲會畀到我膚色一種健康嘅光澤。我嘅皮膚睇落更加光亮同均勻。一定會回購！✨

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Boosting Toner 210ml
reviews.text: SKIN1004 has been great with so many of their products. Excited to try this one. Did not like their Poremizing range. But that might not be suitable for my skin type
reviews.zh: SKIN1004 好多產品都做得好好。好期待試呢款。唔鍾意佢哋嘅 Poremizing 系列。不過可能係唔啱我嘅膚質。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Boosting Toner 210ml
reviews.text: This is an amazing toner, I use it a lot. One of the only ones that I saw a difference in my face after using it after sometime. Great consistency, no detectable smell, and great look on the skin.
reviews.zh: 呢款爽膚水真係好正，我用得好密。係少數我用咗一段時間之後，塊面真係見到分別嘅爽膚水之一。質地好好，冇咩明顯氣味，上臉嘅效果亦都好正。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Boosting Toner 210ml
reviews.text: 安かったから買ったけどあんまわからん😔😔😔😔
reviews.zh: 因為平所以買咗，但係都唔太清楚有冇用😔😔😔😔

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Boosting Toner 210ml
reviews.text: The refreshing toner helps hydrate, soothe, and gently brighten the skin. With regular use, it leaves the skin looking more even, smooth, and naturally radiant—great for daily skincare routines.
reviews.zh: 呢款清爽爽膚水有助保濕、舒緩同輕輕提亮肌膚。持續使用之後，皮膚會睇落更加均勻、滑溜，仲有自然嘅光澤感——好啱日常護膚程序。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Boosting Toner 210ml
reviews.text: This is my first time trying this product. I haven’t noticed any skin-brightening effect yet, but it is very hydrating and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. So far, I haven’t seen any other significant results. However, I was disappointed that all of the packaging arrived dirty and dusty, which affected the overall impression of the product
reviews.zh: 我係第一次用呢款產品。到目前為止未見到有咩提亮效果，不過佢真係好保濕，吸收得快又唔會黐笠笠。到依家為止，仲未見到其他明顯效果。不過，令我失望嘅係所有包裝送達嘅時候都好污糟同多塵，影響咗我對呢款產品嘅整體印象。
